raw.quote: מביא לך עוד עבודות ועוד ביקורות בגוגל
raw.reader_consequence: The spoken promise of more jobs and more Google reviews is ledger B29 (NEEDS-PROOF) and contradicts Site Bot terms §9 (no commitment to calls or enquiries); the review-request mechanism it rests on (B13) is not live and its copy is marked 'Do not ship'. The tradesman who taps expects delivered jobs/reviews from a product that cannot yet produce them, and the free audit he lands on cannot substantiate the promise.
